notes: One-click TikTok connect: the app now ships an embedded TikTok app key and uses the secure PKCE login flow, so you (and testers) no longer paste a Client Key/Secret in Settings — just click Connect, approve in TikTok, done. The Client Secret is never shipped (PKCE), so it stays safe even though the updates repo is public. Settings → Connect accounts: the TikTok card now shows only a Connect button. server.js (OAuth start/callback/refresh now use the embedded key + code_verifier) and index.html.
